html:
Elena the Traveler, or Elena the Seer, is one of the holy Mothers, the fifth in the canon of Scripture after Miriam, Janmei, Sophia and Agatha. (Foremothers) It patronizes travelers, sailors, cartographers and merchants. They pray before a long journey and in a sea storm. Sailors who survived the storm said, “Glory to Elena the Traveler.”

Miracles and Objects

According to Adrian’s masters who studied the Objects, “Helena could see from a great distance, through all obstacles.” For this purpose, she served as her personal Subject - Bird without Flesh, "one of the primordial Objects of the Foremothers." It was later stored in Shimmery. In The Shadow of the Great Tree, Adrian, having received the Bird from Francis-Ilian, promised the guests to "repeat the miracle of the Mother Elena."

Travels

  • Polaris maps. According to the “Guide to the lands of Polari”, Elena made “very detailed maps”. They were marked with great accuracy silver deposits in the Crystal Mountains. Therefore, the mountains began to be developed early, in the III century, and next to the mines grew the first northern cities - Leed, Main and Steel.
  • Rei-Roy. In Humans and Gods, the Second of the Five claimed that, according to ancient writings, Rei-Roy was also founded by the Foremothers. Elena-Traveler climbed behind Holliwell and for a long time walked along the Steppe to the west. In the parking lot, she had a beautiful dream, and she realized that this was a sacred place. Elena founded a fort there, which later grew into a city.
  • Boarding. The boarding house of Elena-u-Lake is built where, according to legend, the Mother visited. (Elena-by-the-Lake Boarding School) Her book People and Lands is one of the student books, along with Agatha's Moments and Yangmei's diaries.

Temples

The churches of Helena the Traveler decorate "pictures of distant lands and raging seas." In Leongard, the sea gate of Hope, stands the temple of Elena-Na-Wave with a majestic colonnade. In Fantasia, the port church in Winslow is painted with ships, seagulls, mermaids and Elena-Travelers. (Fantasies) In "Confident" the abbess boasted of a sculpture of Foremother Elena in the monastery gazebo - an exact copy of the famous statue. (The Confidante) Harmon had a silver medallion with the image of Elena the Seer, and in captivity he prayed to her.

Rod Elena

The Elenites are below the four older genera. According to Karen, Elena's family "does not require their children to be too cool": they are allowed easy sentimentality, romanticism and faith in miracles. Another feature of Elena's grandchildren is intuition, in which only the Agathans compete with them. There is a joke that says, “Elena’s grandson will lose his wife to cards.” The emperors “never” married a lady of Elena’s kind. Therefore, Duke Jonas Lighthart of the family of Elena gave the daughter not for the emperor, but for his brother Manson. In turn, the Yelenites dream about the brides of the Sophia family.

From the family of Elena occur:

  • Karen from Lighthart's house. (House Lightheart) Manson assured that her “bottomless eyes” will not make a mistake in her kind;
  • Most of Lord Henry Farway's descendants: of his twelve grandchildren, ten are of the family of Helen the Traveler;
  • Somerset Flame.

The Author's Article

In 2018, in the section of the author's articles "Polaripedia" - the cycle wiki on Fandom - an unfinished list of "Saints Foremothers" appeared. (Source) It is written before the last books of the cycle; about Elena it says this.

  • Elena is a light cheerful character, impulsive and gambler, eager for changes and discoveries; her talents are navigation and cartography. Its object is called here the Bird Without a Body, or the Aether Bird: it allows you to see through obstacles and beyond the horizon.

The truth about Elena

In Shadow of the Great Tree, Navi said that the Forebears were the crew of a colonial starship, and Elena was its first navigator. When passengers wanted to burn the energy of the surviving bioreactors and send a distress signal, Elena and Agatha argued that the signal would not be noticed through hundreds of parsecs. According to them, bioreactors had to be preserved in order to populate the planet.

In "Fantasies"

Ganta Court, the chief of the Steppes, declared himself a descendant of Pramatery Elena. As if she had lived long with the Spirits of the Steppe and given abundant offspring, so that all the great Shavans — Paul, Moran, and Court itself — come from her.

Trivia

  • Erwin, after catching a cold on a hike, complained: “I’m not a traveler! Then what the hell is Pramary Elena sending me to attack again and again?" Althessa replied, “I think she’s taking revenge on her granddaughter.”
  • In the "collection edition" Karen calls Elena the Astute patroness of sailors, wanderers, cartographers and geographers. (Arrow, Coin, Spark (Collector's Edition))
  • Harmon imagined that God the Jeweler had given the Light Sphere to Elena the Seer, and she gave it to the people. (Radiant Sphere) It's just his fantasy, not his tradition.
